title: phplyr
tagline: A PHP port of the Tidyverse's dplyr and tidyr.
summary: phplyr brings R's dplyr and tidyr to PHP: filtering, grouped summaries, window functions, joins, pivots, and the rest, with dplyr's function names and arguments. Pipelines use PHP 8.5's pipe operator, or method chains on PHP 8.3 and 8.4. They run on phibble's in-memory DataFrame, on databases through SQL, and on Polars.

optional.name: phit extension
optional.for: statistical models and native descriptive statistics
